Description

For Research Use Only. Not for human or veterinary use. Not for use in diagnostic or therapeutic procedures. Not approved by the FDA or any regulatory body for human consumption, treatment, cure, or prevention of any disease.

TB-500 is a synthetic peptide supplied for in-vitro research into actin-binding signaling and cell-migration pathway models.

In research settings, TB-500 is studied for its role in cytoskeletal regulation, particularly in models evaluating endothelial cell migration, angiogenesis assays, and tissue-repair signaling cascades.
